screens.title: 朱砂政务 · 浅色 Light
screens.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE high-fidelity desktop application UI screenshot, landscape 16:10, flat front-on digital design, no device, no collage. Use the referenced previous '政务智办' screenshot as information architecture and refinement reference, but create the specified new theme. The product is a dignified township-government Goose AI workbench. Consistent Chinese sans typography, fine borders, 8px corners, disciplined generous 28px gutters, crisp icons, calm leader-friendly aesthetics. White/near-white text on dark must be readable. Never use neon or cyberpunk. Left sidebar brand '政务智办' and subtitle '镇政府智能工作台', abstract building symbol, NO national emblem or seal. All sidebar routes have thin individual line icons: 工作台, 配方中心, 技能中心, 应用中心, 任务调度, 扩展管理, 会话历史, 主题中心. Bottom left a SETTINGS / ACCOUNT trigger displaying a round initials avatar '张', '张主任', '党政办公室', small gear and chevron. Top breadcrumb, a small neutral badge '界面设计示例', notifications, initials avatar. Every recipe/skill/app/extension card includes an individual meaningful icon tile. Include ARCHIVE CAPABILITIES visibly as cards '档案管理 MCP' with archive-folder icon and small label '待配置凭据', and '档案审核 Skill' with document/shield-check icon and label '证据核对 · 人工复核'. These are design concepts; do not claim active real integration or expose personal records. Small footer 'AI 生成内容请审核后使用'. Product titles and exact text must be legible Chinese, professional and implementable.  THEME '朱砂政务' MODE 'LIGHT'. Palette warm off-white #F7F5F1 main canvas, white #FFFFFF sidebar and cards, charcoal #252B32 text, restrained #B39A67 gold line detail. Main accent #A52830. This screen is '主题中心' (sidebar selected). Heading '主题中心', subtitle '选择政务主题，切换浅色与深色外观。'. Top right compact mode control '浅色 Light', '深色 Dark', '跟随系统', with 浅色 Light visibly selected. Three equal theme cards across, each containing a detailed miniature UI preview split into light and dark miniatures, title '朱砂政务', '深蓝政务', '青山雅政' respectively, color-swatch dots, short style subtitle, and '应用主题' button. Current theme '朱砂政务' card outlined in its primary accent and marked '使用中'. Below a large wide current theme preview panel with tiny sidebar, chat composer, four individual icon resource cards. Below that two full sized resource rows '档案管理 MCP' and '档案审核 Skill' with meaningful distinct icons and labels described above. Keep text restrained and practical.The bottom-left account trigger is collapsed; it should look clickable, with gear/chevron clearly indicating a popup.
